title: Story from Sounds · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Story from Sounds · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Agree on two familiar everyday sounds. The lead tells a short story that includes both sounds, imitating each once. The story includes both chosen sounds and has an ending. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Story from Sounds, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The story includes both chosen sounds and has an ending.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The story includes both chosen sounds and has an ending.
